app/src/lib/format.ts:5-45 — six pure formatting helpers (humanize, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavorText) with zero tests

coverage_of_risk.rationale: None of the app's riskiest logic — filtering, pagination, URL state, sorting, alternate-form exclusion, not-found paths — has a single test; only the external acceptance suite covers it.

behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: There are no tests at all, so there is nothing to assess as behavioural; the floor of the anchor applies.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:17-32 — promise cache with 404 eviction is subtle and untested; a regression to 'cache everything' would break the live-data-overlay behaviour
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:113-121 — METHOD_ORDER comparator with the 99-sentinel trick is easy to break silently and nothing would fail
app/src/routes/index.tsx:55-64 — homeUrl must omit defaults and reset page on filter change; a refactor keeping a stale page param would pass silently
regression_power.rationale: Once the acceptance suite stops being the only guard, essentially every behaviour in the app is unprotected; a refactor of the data layer could break ordering, dedup and exclusion with no signal.

evidence: app/ — zero test files, so no noise either
signal_to_noise.rationale: Anchored at 3 for the no-tests case: there is no padding, but also no signal.

findings.issue: No test runner, no test script, zero test files in the app; the pure data layer (format.ts, api.ts, all five route loaders) is entirely untested
findings.suggestion: Add vitest with unit tests for src/lib (the helpers are pure and need no Qwik context) and a small number of route-level tests via qwik-city's test APIs for the loaders; wire a `test` script into package.json

findings.issue: Combined filter semantics, 48-per-page slicing, page clamping and default-param omission in the URL are untested; a refactor of the list route could break pagination boundaries or filter composition with no failing test
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/slice logic into a testable function and unit-test: no filters (1025), each filter alone, filters combined, last partial page, page beyond totalPages, empty q/type params omitted from homeUrl

findings.issue: The sort comparator (missing-values-last in both directions, numeric vs string columns, direction flip) is private and untested; the classic regression is applying the direction multiplier to the null-handling branch so missing values sort first when descending
findings.suggestion: Export compareValues (or move it to lib) and unit-test nulls-last in both directions for every column, plus the toggle/aria-sort behaviour in a rendered-component test

findings.issue: Move aggregation per game is the densest logic in the app — dedup by move+method keeping the minimum level, method ordering with the 99-sentinel indexOf comparator, default game = highest order, level-up default sort — all untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the aggregation against a small fixture pokemon payload: multiple version_group_details for the same move (min level wins), method order including an unknown method sorted alphabetically, and ?game= fallback for an unknown game

findings.issue: Cache semantics (successes cached forever, 404s and failures evicted) are load-bearing for the spec's 'live API' requirement and untested; caching a null or rejected promise would make the app show stale not-founds after data changes
findings.suggestion: Unit-test apiGet with a stubbed fetch: 404 returns null and is not cached (a later success is served), a rejected fetch doesn't poison the cache, a success is served from cache on second call

findings.issue: idFromUrl regex and the isDefaultPokemonId < 10000 boundary drive every 'alternate forms excluded' list (moves, abilities, types pages); a subtle change would silently include Mega forms or drop valid species
findings.suggestion: Unit-test idFromUrl against trailing-slash and no-trailing-slash URLs and NaN cases, and isDefaultPokemonId at the 9999/10000 boundary

findings.issue: Not-found paths (unknown species name, unknown move/ability/type, excluded types like 'shadow') are untested; the dual-fetch species-then-pokemon 404 flow and the status(404) calls could regress to 200s or wrong headings
findings.suggestion: Add route tests asserting h1 'Not found', the link to /, and 404 status for /pokemon/missingno, /types/shadow and an arbitrary URL

findings.issue: englishName/latestEnglishFlavorText pick the English entry and the LAST English entry respectively; a refactor to `.find` forward-scan for flavor text would return the oldest entry and no test would notice
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests for the format helpers covering empty arrays, non-English entries, \f/\n collapse and the 4-digit padStart

summary: The app ships with no tests of any kind — no runner, no script, no files — despite a data layer that is mostly pure functions tailor-made for cheap unit tests. The riskiest logic (filter composition and pagination on the home route, the nulls-last column sorting, per-game move dedup and method ordering, and the API cache's 404 eviction) is guarded only by the acceptance suite, so a data-layer refactor would likely break ordering, dedup or pagination silently. Adding vitest coverage of src/lib plus a handful of loader-level tests would convert this from a 1 to a solid 3-4 with modest effort.
